question: The compound interest (in ₹, nearest to a rupee) on a sum of ₹7,500 at 24% p.a. for 3 months, interest compounded monthly, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**In question compound interest calculate in monthly

Interest for 12 month = 24%

Then for 1 month = 2%

Compound interest = [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53b7476ca2b9e586c434fddda30e121bfd2fc67a9c43370563ae116dcd502bc8.png] 

CI = 150 + 150 + 150 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 0.06 = 459.06 ≈ Rs. 459

**∴ Required compound interest is Rs. 459. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Principle = Rs. 7,500

Rate per annum = 24%

Time = 3 month

**Formula used:**

Compound interest = P[(1 + (r)/(100))^t - 1]

**Calculation:**

Interest for 12 month = 24%

⇒ Then for 1 month = 2%

Compound interest = 7500[(1 + (2)/(100))³ - 1]

⇒ 7500[((51)/(50))³ - 1]

⇒ 7500((132651 - 125000)/(125000))

⇒ 7500times (7651)/(125000)

⇒ 459.06 ≈ Rs. 459

∴ Required compound interest is Rs. 459. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Compound interest is the addition of interest to the principle sum of loan or deposit, or in other words, interest on principle plus interest.

or interest on (Principle + interest)
